name: Stage Character Focus / Selection Hinge 01
bounded_question: What non-color floor/name-hinge grammar best distinguishes transient keyboard focus from persistent creator selection on the Stage while leaving the Character cone materially unchanged and preserving separation from Current Opportunity, Speaking and Take a Seat?
single_variable: persistent selected-state witness geometry at the fixed Character floor/name hinge
common_focus_law: All scored F1-F4 candidates use the same transient keyboard-focus carrier: a 2px currentColor outer ellipse around a fixed floor/name hinge footprint with 2px clearance. Focus does not alter cone, pool, name metrics, state label or selection witness.
authority_limits: USER SELECTION != CURRENT OPPORTUNITY != SPEAKING != TAKE A SEAT.
Selection is persistent creator focus only and creates no fictional action.
The cone itself remains materially unchanged under focus or selection.
Visible feedback remains local to the floor/name hinge and never reveals the full Character hit-target rectangle.
PKT-STA-01-01 F2 Ring + Edge Witness and CMP-01 are prior mechanics/compatibility evidence only, not automatic Stage authority.
No outcome creates production focus-management semantics, native tokens, implementation or final palette/motion authority.

neutral_stage_scaffold.purpose: Test Stage-specific focus/selection mechanics without importing final palette, cone-state optics, identity cues or creator-action chrome.
neutral_stage_scaffold.carrier: neutral static tapered light volume over a fixed floor ellipse with explicit Character name and state label
neutral_stage_scaffold.motion: none; no authored transition or animation
neutral_stage_scaffold.identity: human-readable name plus stable fixture id; one neutral identical placeholder cue may be shown but carries no scored identity or state meaning
neutral_stage_scaffold.cone_geometry: identical within each layout across default/focus/selected/focus+selected conditions
neutral_stage_scaffold.floor_geometry: identical within each layout across focus/selection conditions; no candidate may broaden, tighten, brighten or move the pool
neutral_stage_scaffold.hinge_footprint: fixed local footprint below the cone containing floor edge, name and state label; selection/focus decoration may not extend into the beam body
neutral_stage_scaffold.implementation_semantics: focusable fixture elements are browser-test instrumentation only and do not select production control semantics

CNEG.name: No Authored Selection Witness
CNEG.selection: no additional structural carrier; explicit fixture label remains
CNEG.expected_failure: Persistent creator selection is not visually recoverable once keyboard focus leaves.

CINC.name: Incumbent Prototype Pill + Pool Outline
CINC.role: historical Stage-scaffold control, not incumbent authority
CINC.focus: rounded name pill plus pool outline/halo
CINC.selection: same rounded name pill plus pool outline/halo
CINC.expected_failure: Focus and selection collapse while the name treatment becomes chip/card-like and overstates software-container geometry.

F1.name: Name Underline Witness
F1.selection: 2px currentColor underline centered under the human-readable name, width 70% of the rendered name block, 4px clear of glyphs
F1.intent: Keep persistence attached to explicit identity while avoiding pool/state mutation.

F2.name: Low Ground Edge Witness
F2.selection: 3px currentColor low horizontal witness, 38px wide at wide scale, centered at the lower edge of the fixed hinge footprint and detached from name/pool
F2.intent: Faithful Stage adaptation of STA-01 F2 edge-witness logic without importing generic button geometry.

F3.name: Lateral Ground Witness
F3.selection: 3px currentColor vertical witness, 26px high at the inline-start edge of the fixed hinge footprint, vertically centered on the floor/name transition and never mirrored into a bracket pair
F3.intent: Test a single peripheral persistence mark that does not underline text or trace the pool.

F4.name: Shallow Ground Arc
F4.selection: 2px currentColor lower arc following 42% of the fixed floor-ellipse width, centered beneath the pool with no top or side enclosure
F4.intent: Test a Stage-native ground-following witness while falsifying seat/occupation and Opportunity-like readings.

fixed_geometry.geometry_law: Candidate state changes may add only their frozen pseudo-element/witness. Beam, pool, hinge, name and state-label boxes must remain pixel-identical across conditions within a layout.

layout_law.L2_SELECTED_RIGHT: two Characters; right Character selected, left default; no state-salience stress
layout_law.L3_FOCUS_LEFT: three Characters; left Character is the actual keyboard-focus target; center Character carries explicit CURRENT OPPORTUNITY text; right default
layout_law.L4_FOCUS_SELECTED_THIRD: four Characters; third Character is selected and actual keyboard-focus target; second carries explicit SPEAKING text; remaining peers REST/LISTENING
layout_law.L5_SELECTED_OPPORTUNITY_SECOND: five Characters; second Character is selected while explicitly CURRENT OPPORTUNITY; a different peer is SPEAKING; tests coexistence without conflation
layout_law.L5_SELECTED_SPEAKING_FOURTH: five Characters; fourth Character is selected while explicitly SPEAKING; another peer is CURRENT OPPORTUNITY; tests coexistence without conflation

matrix.name_law: Names and state labels remain explicit and identical across family comparisons; no candidate changes copy, typography or state assignment.
matrix.ordering_law: Families are rendered in fixed CNEG/CINC/F1/F2/F3/F4 order for diagnostics. Human review may inspect candidates in an anonymized order generated before first exposure if useful; controls remain identified as calibration.

browser_preflight.actual_keyboard_law: DevTools-dispatched sequential Tab focus must reach the designated enabled target in L3 and L4 for every family at both viewport widths and produce visible :focus-visible geometry. Scripted HTMLElement.focus() alone is not keyboard-focus evidence.
browser_preflight.forced_colors_law: Focus ellipse and F1-F4 selection witnesses remain structurally visible with system/currentColor equivalents; comprehension may not depend on grayscale fixture values.
browser_preflight.narrow_law: At 320 CSS px boards reflow vertically; no horizontal document overflow, hidden name/state text or selection witness clipping is allowed.
browser_preflight.reduced_motion_law: No authored animation or transition exists; prefers-reduced-motion therefore preserves an identical static state.

mechanical_falsifiers: Any focus or selection condition changes beam, pool, name-block or state-label layout geometry rather than adding only the frozen local carrier.
Keyboard focus is not visible with color removed or fails to remain independently visible when combined with selection.
A selected witness clips, disappears or causes horizontal overflow at 320 CSS px.
A candidate depends on authored hue, glow, motion, texture, exact Character position or portrait recognition.
A candidate changes or obscures explicit Character name/state text.
A candidate alters Current Opportunity or Speaking fixture assignment when selection changes.
A candidate extends into the beam body or reveals the rectangular semantic hit target.
Forced-colors removes the focus carrier or persistent selection witness needed for comprehension.

CNEG unexpectedly provides durable authored selection legibility or CINC unexpectedly preserves independent focus and selection; either control failure invalidates calibration rather than promoting a candidate.
subjective_falsification_after_clean_pre: focus and persistent selection collapse into one visual state
selection primarily reads as Current Opportunity, Speaking, status, validation, progress or narrative nomination
selection reads as Take a Seat, occupied-seat ownership or creator possession rather than inspect/focus persistence
the treatment turns the Character into a button, chip, card, avatar container or boxed selectable object
the treatment resembles crop/edit/resize tooling or a navigation-tab indicator
the selection witness becomes more visually authoritative than Character presence/name/state
the mechanism depends on the exact pool shape or mutable state modulation rather than the floor/name hinge
focus plus selection becomes visually congested or less legible than either state alone
the mechanism fails to transfer across 2-5 Character layouts or becomes ambiguous on a selected Character who is also Opportunity/Speaking
the mechanism is so generic or faint that it adds no useful persistent-selection legibility beyond explicit fixture text

decision_law.selection_rule: A candidate survives only if every mechanical requirement passes and none of the frozen subjective falsifiers binds materially across the matrix.
decision_law.tie_or_mixed_tradeoff_rule: If no candidate is materially cleaner than the others, record zero survivors rather than choosing by taste.
decision_law.promotion_scope: A sole survivor becomes provisional neutral Stage focus/selection-hinge evidence only and must later pass a separately frozen exact-incumbent Stage integration comparison before changing PKT-STAGE-CORE-02.
decision_law.non_authority: No result freezes production dimensions, native focus management, color, motion, Take-a-Seat treatment, action hierarchy or implementation tokens.

source_freeze.method_freeze_point: This JSON contract must parse, pass recursive source audit and be committed before any harness specimen is materialized or viewed.
source_freeze.harness_hash_law: The exact harness SHA-256 is recorded in a separate structural/accessibility preflight record before first visual exposure; this method file is not mutated after its freeze commit.
source_freeze.visual_exposure_law: No screenshot, browser review surface or subjective candidate judgment may occur until the harness bytes and browser probe are source-audited and hash-frozen.

next_action.action: After this exact method contract is committed and hosted-valid, materialize the deterministic neutral SEL-S1 harness, verifier and browser probe; source-audit and hash-freeze them before first visual exposure.
first_exposure_requires: common keyboard-focus ellipse invariant across F1-F4
